title: Sea of crimson: vivid ‘red beach’ transforms China’s wetlands and marshes – in pictures
summary:
A striking transformation takes place along the coast of Qingdao in autumn, when a native seepweed turns a brilliant shade of red.

The ‘red beach’ phenomenon can be seen in the salt marshes and wetlands on the coast of China’s Shandong province, where the Suaeda glauca plant matures and absorbs water, changing it from green to crimson between September and November
